title: Microsoft Azure Examples
description: Small Microsoft Azure examples from the lessons. Each example links back to its explanation and practice task.

examples.title: Meet the Azure cloud
examples.description: Microsoft Azure offers rented services for computing, storage and networking. A useful design begins with the job, not with the longest list of services.
examples.code:
Goal: publish a small static club page
Inputs: HTML, CSS and image files
Decision: choose a static-file hosting option

examples.title: Subscriptions and resource groups
examples.description: An Azure subscription is a billing and management boundary. A resource group collects related resources for a project.
examples.code:
Subscription: approved learning subscription
Resource group: rg-club-practice
Resources: storage and monitoring for the club project

examples.title: Regions and availability
examples.description: An Azure region is a geographic area. Many regions offer availability zones, which provide separate physical locations within the region.
examples.code:
Choose a supported region
Check whether the chosen service supports zones there
Plan copies if the availability need justifies them

examples.title: Microsoft Entra identities
examples.description: Microsoft Entra ID manages identities. An identity can represent a person, application or workload, depending on how access is arranged.
examples.code:
Person identity: a reviewer
Workload identity: an approved application
Access decision: assign only the required role at the right scope

examples.title: Azure role assignments
examples.description: Azure role-based access control assigns a role to an identity at a scope. Scope can be a resource, resource group or broader boundary.
examples.code:
Identity: fictional reviewer
Role: Reader
Scope: rg-club-practice

examples.title: Blob Storage containers
examples.description: Azure Blob Storage keeps objects called blobs. Containers group blobs inside a storage account.
examples.code:
Storage account -> container club-files
Container -> blob images/logo.png

examples.title: Static website files
examples.description: An Azure Storage static website uses an index document and an error document. It is a way to serve files, not an application backend.
examples.code:
Index document: index.html
Error document: 404.html
Content: compiled frontend files

examples.title: Virtual machines need upkeep
examples.description: An Azure virtual machine is a configurable computer in the cloud. Its operating system and software still need care.
examples.code:
Planned VM: one Linux practice machine
Owner tasks: updates, accounts, disk care and monitoring

examples.title: Virtual networks and subnets
examples.description: A virtual network provides a private network space. Subnets divide that space into smaller address ranges for resources.

examples.title: Network security groups
examples.description: A network security group contains rules that allow or deny network traffic. Rules have priorities, so their order matters.
examples.code:
Rule priority 100: allow approved HTTPS traffic
Later rules: handle other traffic according to the plan

examples.title: Azure Monitor helps you observe
examples.description: Azure Monitor collects supported metrics and logs. Alerts can tell you when a chosen condition is met.
examples.code:
Metric: failed requests
Alert: more failures than the agreed threshold
Investigation: compare logs and recent changes

examples.title: Cost planning and cleanup
examples.description: Azure budgets can notify you about spending. Review actual resource costs and plan cleanup; notifications are not a general guarantee that spending stops.
examples.code:
Fictional budget: 10 units
Alert at 80 percent: 8 units
Cleanup list: only resources created for this approved practice
